protocol.axis: parent local Z expressed in world, fixed at the checkpoint
protocol.forcePolicy: All dynamic bodies resetForces(true)/resetTorques(true) identically before the shared response snapshot. No pose/velocity/mass setters. Gravity unchanged. Passive leg joint recreation drops leg solver history; upper/upright native retained. Cached native combat hooks are used; combat/controller updates are not run.
protocol.interpretation: State-dependent coupled one-step response, not an exact effective inertia identification, a motor gain prescription, a recovery acceptance test or a human material measurement.

branchCountDefinition: 4 natural checkpoints × 3 selected joints × (2 zero repeats + 2 signs × 2 impulse magnitudes) = 72 simulation branches; not human participants or independent human samples.

measurementDefinitions.freePairInverseInertia: axis dot (effectiveWorldInvInertia_child + effectiveWorldInvInertia_parent) axis; predicts immediate impulse response before constraints step.
measurementDefinitions.centralToFreePairRatio: Measured post-step centralGain divided by freePairInverseInertia; a constrained one-step response ratio, not intrinsic inertia.
measurementDefinitions.nativeSerialization: Original snapshot bytes shared by all branches; restored body state exactly matches original and all restored-native hashes match one another. Restored native reserialization differs from original byte stream.

limits: Only one deterministic seed and one controller path per healthy/hurt scenario.
The snapshots retain pose-specific upper native motors and upright; no zero-upright ablation in this experiment.
Six leg joint recreation removes leg motor/solver history; those motors stay never configured.
All dynamic user forces/torques are reset uniformly before response snapshot; this differs from a full controller step with current support forces.
One-step response includes constraints, contacts/friction, damping, upper motors and native solver effects.
Healthy/hurt checkpoints differ in pose, contact, mass/inertia and upper motor settings; not a weak-leg-only causal comparison.
Snapshot byte streams are restored during execution but not exported; hashes and explicit states are recorded.
